data.text:
#PROTESTA: The third of big anti-corruption rallies this 2025. 

Civil society organizations, the Church, youth groups, political coalitions, progressive groups and ordinary citizens went out to the streets today to call out widespread corruption in and around Philippine government. 

The Trillion Peso March 2.0 happened at the EDSA People Power Monument, amplifying calls against corruption and political dynasties. Several progressive groups trooped to the Baha sa Luneta 2.0 at Luneta Park, calling for resignations from the Top 2 officials of the land, with a proposal for a "transition council". Pro-Duterte groups, on the other hand, were seen gathering around Liwasang Bonifacio, and heading to Mendiola. 

Salamat sa pagtutok sa aming special coverage kasama si Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Claire Castro. @News5PH
